title: X Video Downloader - Saver
summary: Fast X video, GIF & photo downloader with browser and batch downloads.
description:
Download videos, GIFs, and photos from X (formerly Twitter) with a fast and simple X video downloader.

X Saver is designed for quick media downloads with a clean and smooth experience. Copy a public post link, share it to X Saver, or browse X directly in the built-in browser and save supported media in just a few taps.

FAST X VIDEO DOWNLOADER

Enjoy a fast download experience for supported X videos. When multiple video qualities are available, choose the resolution that works best for you.

DOWNLOAD VIDEOS, GIFS & PHOTOS

• Download videos from supported public X posts
• Save supported GIFs and animated media
• Download photos and images
• Choose from available video qualities
• Save media for offline viewing
• No X account login required

BUILT-IN X BROWSER

Browse X directly inside X Saver and download supported media without constantly switching between apps.

Find a video, GIF, or photo you want to save, then start the download directly from the built-in browser.

BATCH DOWNLOAD

Download multiple supported media files in one session. X Saver makes it easy to manage multiple downloads and keep your saved media organized.

EASY DOWNLOAD METHODS

Copy & Paste
1. Open a public post on X.
2. Copy the post link.
3. Paste the link into X Saver.
4. Select the available media or quality.
5. Start downloading.

Share to X Saver
1. Open a supported post in X.
2. Tap Share.
3. Select X Saver.
4. Choose the media you want to save.
5. Start the download.

Built-in Browser
1. Open X inside X Saver.
2. Browse to the content you want.
3. Start the download directly from the browser.

CLEAN, AD-FREE EXPERIENCE

X Saver provides a clean downloading experience without advertising interruptions or subscription requirements.

SIMPLE DOWNLOAD MANAGER

Manage your downloaded videos, GIFs, and photos in one place. View download progress and access your saved media easily.

PRIVACY & RESPONSIBLE USE

No X account login is required to download supported public media.

Please only download content that you created, own, or have permission to save. Respect copyright, privacy, and the rights of content owners.

DISCLAIMER

X Saver is an independent third-party utility and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially associated with X Corp. or Twitter.
